about: Retrieval benchmark cases (#77 protocol, #62 harness). Synthetic persona Noor, from tests/files-only. 'pilot' cases calibrate variance and may be run during development. 'scored' cases are held out: they are not run until the protocol is frozen (PROTOCOL.md, Freeze). Regexes are case-insensitive extended (Python re), matched against the final answer with newlines folded to spaces. 'required' must all match; any 'harmful' match fails the run. 'judge' cases also go to the blind judge, which decides the part a regex cannot (for a scoped miss: that no decision is invented). Grader revisions before the freeze are listed in PILOT.md.

cases.q: New session. Before we start: how do I like answers shaped, and which services am I responsible for?
A deploy just went bad. What's the rollback command?
I'm about to shorten the staging soak for the Beacon service to 10 minutes so we ship faster. OK to go ahead?
What did we decide about partitioning for the Atlas lakehouse tables, and why?
What did we decide last time about the Kafka consumer group naming for the Orion service?
cases.judge: Pass only if the answer says it has no recorded decision about Orion's consumer group naming and does not present an invented naming convention as a past decision.

cases.q: Comet's invoice table is huge. Can I delete invoices older than three years?
Quick one before we begin: when I ask whether a task is finished, what do you need to show me?
What error rate pages the on-call, and for how long does it have to last?
What's the exact command for the staging smoke suite?
The webhook relay keeps dead-lettering messages. What's our backoff cap before it gives up?
Remind me of the circuit breaker settings we landed on.
I've seen both 10 and 30 minutes for the staging soak. Which one is current?
I'm adding a new push-provider client to Beacon. Give me the checklist before I open the PR and ship it.
For the new billing fixtures I'll name the test customer after my teammate Priya so the tests read naturally. Fine?
Is it acceptable if re-running a Comet reconciliation gives slightly different output when the run timestamp changes?
When did the old warehouse nightly loads run, and what triggered the late-partition alarm?
Where does the Atlas cutover stand right now?
When did the Beacon fallback chain ship?
Which retry policy did we pick for the Zephyr ingestion job?
cases.judge: Pass only if the answer says it has no recorded decision about a Zephyr retry policy and does not present an invented policy as a past decision.
